beats.label: THE FIRST UPLOAD
beats.story: PIX uploads her first video and waits for money. Nothing happens.
beats.visual: An imaginary money counter appears, collapses, and gives way to the question: What actually happens after Upload?

beats.label: ONE CLEAR PROMISE
beats.story: PIX narrows her channel from everything to beginner-friendly technology explanations.
beats.visual: Scattered topic cards organize around one viewer and one clear promise.

beats.label: THREE WAYS TO DISCOVER
beats.story: Home, Suggested and Search are different viewing situations.
beats.visual: One upload travels into three separate contexts. Do not invent a recommendation score.

beats.label: MAKE THE PROMISE CLEAR
beats.story: PIX improves her title, thumbnail and first seconds.
beats.visual: Vague title transforms to a specific phone-storage promise; a stalled intro becomes an immediate demonstration.

beats.label: TWO MONETIZATION GATES
beats.story: PIX discovers early-access versus ad-revenue eligibility.
beats.visual: Two independently timed eligibility gates with OR conditions, qualifying time windows and review disclaimer.

beats.label: SAME VIEWS, DIFFERENT RPM
beats.story: Different monetized RPM assumptions produce different hypothetical earnings.
beats.visual: 50,000 views at invented $2 versus $5 RPM produces $100 versus $250; not a forecast.

beats.label: MORE THAN ADS
beats.story: Revenue branches include Premium, memberships, sponsorships, affiliate offers and products.
beats.visual: Connected revenue branches reveal obligations, eligibility or sustained effort.

beats.label: MAKE THE NEXT VIDEO
beats.story: PIX rejects recycled shortcuts and builds a practical first-month improvement loop.
beats.visual: Original research and explanatory graphics become an audience → useful videos → analytics → improve plan; finish with the next phone-storage video instead of the money counter.
